checks.name: authentication-authorisation
checks.output_summary: No auth required for local demo. Single-user, no privileged data. Accepted.

checks.name: input-validation
checks.output_summary: No user input in request body. Bob response validated through AnalysisBundleWireSchema.safeParse() before field access.

checks.name: output-handling
checks.output_summary: No dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Error messages are static strings. Two low-severity info-disclosure patterns noted (SEC-FIND-001, SEC-FIND-002).

checks.name: injection
checks.output_summary: No SQL, shell, template, or code injection paths. Guardrail test code is display-only text.

checks.name: ssrf
checks.output_summary: Outbound URL is operator-configured via BOB_API_URL env var. No user-supplied URL parameter. Info-level only.

checks.name: path-traversal
checks.output_summary: ALLOWED_PATHS is a hard-coded compile-time constant. No user input in path construction. Defence-in-depth gap noted (SEC-FIND-005, info).

checks.name: secret-exposure
checks.output_summary: BOB_API_KEY in Authorization header only. Never logged, never in response body, never in client bundle. SEC-601 through SEC-607 all pass.

checks.name: dependency-security
checks.output_summary: No new dependencies added. Existing dependencies unchanged.

checks.name: unsafe-configuration
checks.output_summary: strict:true in tsconfig. No CSP headers (info-level for local demo, SEC-FIND-004). No CORS wildcards. No dangerouslyAllowSVG.

findings.message: Filesystem error message (including absolute server path) forwarded to client response body
findings.evidence: const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error reading source files'; return NextResponse.json({ error: 'source_read_failed', message }, { status: 500 });
findings.suggested_action: Replace raw err.message with a static message such as 'Could not read analysis source files.' Log the actual error server-side only. This prevents server filesystem path leakage.

findings.message: Raw Bob API error text (up to 200 chars) included in BobApiError.message and forwarded to client by route handler
findings.evidence: throw new BobApiError(`Bob API returned HTTP ${response.status}: ${text.slice(0, 200)}`, response.status); // then route.ts:47 returns err.message to client
findings.suggested_action: For production: replace upstream error body forwarding with a static 'Bob analysis request failed — see server logs.' and log the full error server-side. This prevents internal API error details from propagating to client responses.

findings.message: POST /api/analyze is unauthenticated and has no server-side rate limiting or in-flight guard
findings.evidence: No auth check present. Client-side isAnalyzing guard is UX-only, not a security control.
findings.suggested_action: For any non-local deployment: add server-side rate limiting or an in-flight request guard to prevent credential exhaustion. The client-side button-disable is insufficient as a security control.

findings.message: No HTTP security headers (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options) configured
findings.suggested_action: Before any public deployment, add a headers() function in next.config.ts with Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.message: No explicit startsWith(base) boundary assertion after path.join — defence-in-depth gap if ALLOWED_PATHS ever became dynamic
findings.evidence: const absolutePath = path.join(base, relativePath); — no startsWith check before readFile call.
findings.suggested_action: Add a boundary assertion before readFile: if (!absolutePath.startsWith(base + path.sep)) throw new Error('Path outside repository root'). This is a zero-cost defence-in-depth measure that protects against future modifications to ALLOWED_PATHS.
